name: AcQuitOption
description: Used with the Quit method to specify whether or not to save changes to the database when quitting Microsoft Access.

constants.name: acQuitPrompt
constants.description: Displays a dialog box that asks whether you want to save any database objects that have been changed but not saved.

constants.name: acQuitSaveAll
constants.description: (Default) Saves all objects without displaying a dialog box.

constants.name: acQuitSaveNone
constants.description: Quits Microsoft Access without saving any objects.
